title: District Commission's Obligation to Impose Costs for Adjournment

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint against a company in the District Commission. The company requests an adjournment, which is granted under the second proviso to sub-section (7) of section 38. The consumer seeks costs for the adjournment.
content.outcome: The District Commission must impose costs for the adjournment as per the regulations under the second proviso to sub-section (7) of section 38.

user_queries: What are the rules for adjournment in the District Commission?
Can the District Commission impose costs for adjournment?
